metadata.title: Monochromatic Blue Portrait with Lower-Right Typography

retrievalProfile.description: A monochromatic blue-toned close-up portrait featuring staggered sans-serif text in the lower-right corner.
excludeWhen: high-contrast black and white is requested

recipe.visualDefinition: A tight, slightly angled headshot of a male subject, processed with a heavy blue monochromatic tint. The lighting is soft and even, minimizing harsh shadows. In the bottom right, two lines of lowercase sans-serif text are staggered, with the top line in white and the bottom line in a contrasting yellow-gold.
coreVisualRelationships: Monochromatic blue palette vs. yellow-gold accent text
Tight facial crop vs. negative space in the upper corners
Staggered text alignment vs. the subject's shoulder line
Soft-focus background vs. sharp typographic edges
coreInvariants: Uniform blue monochromatic color grading across the entire image

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The face occupies approximately 70% of the frame, centered horizontally but slightly tilted.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eyes serve as the primary focal point, anchored by the text block in the lower right.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The viewer's eye starts at the subject's eyes, moves down the bridge of the nose to the mouth, and finally rests on the high-contrast text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal negative space, primarily located in the upper-right and upper-left corners behind the hair.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the blue spectrum with low value contrast, creating a glowing, ethereal effect.
paletteRestrictions: Strictly monochromatic blue for the image
White and yellow-gold for typography only

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Color-based hierarchy using a single typeface family.
graphicDevices: Staggered indentation for the second line of text

candidateDirections.reason: Clean, neutral geometric forms match the modern aesthetic.
Provides a friendly but professional geometric structure.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a close-up portrait of a male subject with a slight smile, then apply a heavy monochromatic cyan-blue filter to the entire image, ensuring highlights are light blue and shadows are deep navy.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two lines of lowercase sans-serif text in the bottom right corner. The first line should be white and left-aligned. The second line should be yellow-gold and indented to the right of the first line's start point.

verificationChecks: Is the image entirely monochromatic blue?
Is the text lowercase and sans-serif?
Is the second line of text yellow-gold and staggered?
Is the portrait a tight headshot crop?

adjustableVariables: Specific shade of the yellow accent

mustAchieve: Legible text contrast against the blue background

postGenerationChecks: Check that no original skin tones are visible through the blue filter.
Verify the text is in the lower-right quadrant.
Ensure the yellow text is clearly distinct from the white text.
Confirm the crop is tight on the face and shoulders.
recipe.reuseFormula: Monochromatic Blue Filter + Tight Portrait Crop + Staggered Lower-Right Sans-Serif Typography
